about_the_game:
Huddle Genius is your ultimate draft assistant for dominating Best Ball fantasy football. Built with precision and packed with smart features, Huddle Genius guides you through every pick with real-time insights, intelligent tiered rankings, stacking logic, exposure tracking, and more — all while adapting to your unique draft strategy.

Whether you're a seasoned veteran or diving into Best Ball for the first time, Huddle Genius gives you the edge you need to build high-upside, well-structured rosters that can win in tournaments or crush your friends in leagues.

🧠 Key Features

  • Live Draft Assistant
    Reacts in real time to your draft room, dynamically updating rankings and targets based on team needs, positional runs, and player availability.

  • Tier-Based Targeting
    Players are organized into strategic tiers for smarter drafting decisions. Each tier is shuffled with intelligent tiebreakers to simulate real-world variance.

  • Stacking and Correlation Tools
    Automatically identifies and highlights optimal stacking options (QB/WR/TE) and late-season correlations — perfect for chasing Week 17 upside.

  • Exposure Management
    Tracks your player and team exposures across drafts, helping you stay diversified or lean into profitable convictions.

  • Customizable Strategy Engine
    Set specific rules for when to target positions, how to handle bye weeks, and define advanced constraints like exposure pair limits and reach tolerance.

  • Sleek, 16-Bit Inspired Interface
    Nostalgic and clean UI that brings retro vibes to your high-stakes draft room.

Huddle Genius isn’t just a cheat sheet — it’s an evolving, adaptive tool that thinks ahead so you can draft smarter. Win your drafts. Outwit your opponents. Become the Genius in your Huddle.

  • Graphics: OpenGL 4-compliant onboard graphics
